svg.title: Ball Corp Data Agentic Mesh topology with four agent layers connected through a shared Unity Catalog fabric
svg.desc: Four layers of micro agents — source system agents at SAP JDE and FactoryTalk, data lake agents in Databricks, orchestrator agents in AI Foundry, and business domain agents — all communicating through a central Unity Catalog agent fabric

g.text: Agent fabric — Unity Catalog shared state
Message bus, tool registry, execution limits, audit logs, schema manifests
Finance · Supply chain · Quality · Plant ops — each spans multiple source systems
